title: DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Model for Cough Detection
description: Detect the sound of coughing in the vicinity of a microphone
long_description: Enable smarter health and wellness monitoring with the DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Model for Cough Detection. Designed for seamless edge deployment, it reliably detects coughing sounds in real time, empowering microphone-equipped devices with instant audio event recognition.
